notes.title: Dragon Spirits is Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Future Dragon Contractors,

We are thrilled to announce——after a long wait, Dragon Spirits is finally launched! We hope you have prepared yourself to start your adventure at Dragon Spirits, a world where reality and fantasy are intertwined. The game is priced at 9.99 USD / 9.75 EUR, with a release discount of 20% for one week you won’t want to miss out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36299641/a5681c76600b1715855ebaa099d504217bf3e742.png

Dragon Spirits is an academy life backgrounded dragon-collecting adventure RPG, rich in plots and collectible elements. The story text is over 300,000 words in its original language, and the playthrough (side quests cleared) takes over 50 hours. As a new student at the academy, you will learn about the theoretical knowledge of Dragon Spirits, [strike]skip class to[/strike] train your practice skills, freely explore diverse maps, and contract with more than 150 Dragon Spirits including the Four Holy Dragons … … We sincerely hope this journey will bring you unforgettable memories.

It has been two years and eight months since the first release of the demo. Initially, it was just a momentary impulse from my student days. It was the help and support of like-minded friends, the enthusiasm and companionship of players that made this dream come true. I hope this game, which carries personal significance, can go further and resonate with more players.

If you have any questions during playing, welcome to join our discord: https://discord.gg/5CxhkkE Communicate with developers and other players.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074190/

FAQ
Q: Cannot launch the game (crashes or errors), what should I do? 
A: Start the game in compatibility mode. If it still fails to start, uninstall and reinstall the game. It is likely that some files are missing. In extremely rare cases, the computer may be incompatible with the engine. (When the game can be started in compatibility mode but cannot be started in normal mode, possible causes: incorrect installation of DirectX 9, incompatible system, no audio device, etc.)

Q: The graphics are not clear enough, is there a solution? 
A: You can use external tools to enlarge the game window or overlay a sharpening filter. The original resolution of the game is 640x480, and the default setting is to enlarge the window twice. Different systems use different enlargement algorithms, resulting in different displays.

Q: A window popped up in the middle of the game, and then the game exited. What should I do? 
A: It is most likely a BUG, but there is also a very small possibility that the game's memory usage has reached its limit. Take a screenshot of the window and send it to the developer. We will analyze the problem based on the error message.

Q: I manually backed up my save data of Dragon Spirits: Prologue, can I use this save data in the official version of Dragon Spiritis?
A: Sure. Right-click on the game in your Steam library, select "Manage" -> "browse local files". Paste the backed-up "SaveXX.rvdata2" file in the "Save" folder here.

notes.title: Dragon Spirits : Prologue Update Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings our dearest Dragon lovers!

It's been more than two years since the release of "Dragon spirits: Prologue". And now, we are delightful to announce that "Dragon spirits" has received its approval (ISBN 978-7-498-10115-0) and the full content has been ready to be released!
We are doing some last-minute improvements and preparations, and believe us, we won't keep you waiting too long. We shall be announcing the official release date soon!

To celebrate that, we've updated our demo content of "Dragon spirits: Prologue" once again, adding some treasure chests to the map to enrich the exploration experiences.

In addition to that, if you are also interested in aiding us with the final stage of the game's preparation (and some puzzlesolving maybe), you could help us find an extremely mysterious bug in game. 
—— under certain circumstances, or certain inputs, it is possible to magically duplicate the unique trinket!
However, we failed to recreate that stably after countless attempts, thus difficult to fix this issue. (TBH, we don't even know how does it appear in the first place) 
Now we genuinely asking for your assistance. May you lend your wisdom and perception? And we are offering a special in-game gift to those who helped us find the way to recreate it!

Finally, thank you to all players and we hope you will continue enjoying the game in the future!
